# Otter Quotes

Otter Quotes is a technology platform based in Indianapolis, Indiana that helps homeowners and contractors navigate property damage repair projects. For insurance-backed projects, after a homeowner files their own claim with their insurance carrier, Otter Quotes gathers the loss sheet, coordinates professional aerial roof measurements, facilitates material and color selection, runs a competitive bidding process, and delivers a fully executed contract to the winning contractor — ready to start work. Homeowners paying out of pocket can start without an insurance claim. There is no cost for homeowners who provide a copy of their insurance estimate. Homeowners without one pay an upfront charge of as little as $15 for professional measurements that are used by every contractor; that money is refunded if they complete a job on the platform. Contractors pay a percentage-based platform fee only on signed contracts they win.

Otter Quotes does not represent homeowners in their insurance claims and is not a public adjuster. The platform organizes and executes the contractor selection process; on insurance-backed projects that begins after the homeowner has filed their own claim.

## How It Works for Homeowners

- File your own property damage claim with your insurance carrier (or start an out-of-pocket project without one)
- Upload your loss sheet and project details at [otterquote.com/start](https://otterquote.com/start.html)
- Select materials and colors; manufacturers' visualizer tools let you see them on your own house
- Contractors who choose to bid send written bids
- Compare bids and sign with your chosen contractor through the platform
- Otter Quotes delivers a fully executed agreement — no paperwork chasing

## How It Works for Contractors

- Join at [otterquote.com/contractor-join](https://otterquote.com/contractor-join.html)
- Browse project opportunities
- Submit bids with your pricing, warranty terms, and materials
- Receive signed contracts — not leads
- Platform delivers: executed agreement, insurance loss sheet, professional aerial roof measurements, full material specifications, and homeowner contact details
- Pay a percentage-based platform fee only on signed contracts you win
